components.css: .ds-command-rail { height:68px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:24px; padding:0 clamp(18px,3vw,42px); background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); border-bottom:1px solid #32342f; font:16px/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-rail-title { display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:20px; } .ds-rail-title span { color:var(--signal); font-size:.72rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-rail-title h1 { margin:0; font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:2rem; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:-.035em; } .ds-rail-summary { margin:0; color:#c7c8c0; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-rail-summary strong { color:var(--signal); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media(max-width:840px) { .ds-command-rail { height:60px; padding-inline:14px; } .ds-rail-title { gap:12px; } .ds-rail-title h1 { font-size:1.6rem; } .ds-rail-title span { font-size:.62rem; } .ds-rail-summary { font-size:.68rem; } .ds-rail-summary span { display:none; } } @media(max-width:480px) { .ds-rail-summary { display:block; max-width:112px; font-size:.58rem; line-height:1.25; text-align:right; white-space:normal; } }

components.name: Prospect Search Field
components.description: Square underline search with an explicit contextual clear action and slash-key focus shortcut.
components.html: Search, filter, or jump directly to any site.
components.css: .ds-search { padding:20px 22px 16px; background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink); font:16px/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-search label { display:block; font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:clamp(1.55rem,2.2vw,2.2rem); line-height:1; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-search p { margin:7px 0 13px; color:var(--muted); font-size:.78rem; } .ds-search-control { display:grid; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:stretch; border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink); } .ds-search input { width:100%; border:0; border-radius:0; outline:0; background:transparent; padding:10px 0; color:var(--ink); font:inherit; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--muted); } .ds-search-control:focus-within { border-color:var(--focus-green); } .ds-search button { align-self:center; min-height:32px; padding:6px 9px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:var(--row-hover); color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; font-size:.7rem; font-weight:800; } .ds-search button:hover, .ds-search button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-green); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Prospect Jump Select
components.description: Native rank-ordered select that reaches all twenty five prospects and synchronizes the review state.
components.css: .ds-jump { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr); gap:12px; align-items:center; background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink); font:16px/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-jump label { color:var(--muted); font-size:.7rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-jump select { width:100%; min-height:38px; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:0; background:var(--paper); color:var(--ink); padding:7px 30px 7px 9px; cursor:pointer; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-jump select:hover, .ds-jump select:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-green); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-jump select:disabled { cursor:wait; color:var(--muted); }

components.name: Cohort Tabs
components.description: Four equal square cohort tabs with live counts and compact stacked count labels.
components.css: .ds-cohort-tabs { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); border:1px solid var(--ink); background:var(--paper); } .ds-cohort-tabs button { min-height:40px; padding:8px 6px; border:0; border-right:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; font:750 .75rem/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-cohort-tabs button span { color:var(--muted); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-weight:600; } .ds-cohort-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] span { color:var(--signal); } .ds-cohort-tabs button:last-child { border-right:0; } .ds-cohort-tabs button[aria-selected="true"] { background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); } .ds-cohort-tabs button:hover, .ds-cohort-tabs button:focus-visible { background:var(--row-hover); color:var(--ink); outline:2px solid var(--focus-green); outline-offset:-2px; } @media(max-width:480px) { .ds-cohort-tabs button { font-size:.68rem; } .ds-cohort-tabs button span { display:block; margin-top:1px; } }

components.name: Prospect Row
components.description: Ranked full-width selection row with stable padding, lateral state motion, and an explicit Preview action.
components.css: .ds-prospect-row { width:100%; min-height:78px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap:12px; align-items:center; padding:13px 18px; border:0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; font:16px/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; transition:background .28s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .28s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-prospect-row:hover, .ds-prospect-row:focus-visible { background:var(--row-hover); transform:translateX(4px); outline:0; } .ds-prospect-rank { color:var(--muted); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; font-size:.8rem; } .ds-prospect-identity { min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; } .ds-prospect-identity strong { overflow-wrap:anywhere; font-size:.98rem; line-height:1.2; } .ds-prospect-identity small { color:var(--muted); font-size:.72rem; line-height:1.2; } .ds-prospect-view { background:var(--qa-green); padding:5px 7px; font-size:.66rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-prospect-row[aria-current="true"] { background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); } .ds-prospect-row[aria-current="true"] .ds-prospect-rank, .ds-prospect-row[aria-current="true"] small { color:#c7c8c0; } .ds-prospect-row[aria-current="true"] .ds-prospect-view { background:var(--signal); color:var(--ink); } @media(max-width:480px) { .ds-prospect-row { grid-template-columns:28px minmax(0,1fr) auto; padding-inline:14px; } } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-prospect-row { transition-duration:.01ms; } }

components.name: Stage Actions
components.description: Square preview navigation and the lime full-demo action on the ink stage.
components.html: Open full demo
components.css: .ds-stage-actions { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); font:16px/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-stage-actions button, .ds-stage-actions a { min-height:38px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:8px 11px; border:1px solid #777a70; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:var(--paper); cursor:pointer; font-size:.76rem; font-weight:700; text-decoration:none; } .ds-stage-actions a { background:var(--signal); border-color:var(--signal); color:var(--ink); } .ds-stage-actions button:hover, .ds-stage-actions button:focus-visible, .ds-stage-actions a:hover, .ds-stage-actions a:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-stage-actions button:disabled { cursor:not-allowed; opacity:.38; }

components.css: .ds-status-cluster { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; background:var(--ink); } .ds-status { padding:5px 7px; border-radius:0; color:var(--ink); font:800 .64rem/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-ready { background:var(--qa-green); } .ds-hold { background:var(--hold); } .ds-scope { background:var(--paper); }

components.css: .ds-stage { min-width:0; min-height:420px; display:grid; grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; background:var(--ink); color:var(--paper); font:16px/1.45 Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif; } .ds-stage header { min-height:74px; padding:12px clamp(14px,2vw,26px); border-bottom:1px solid #3a3b36; } .ds-stage header p { margin:0 0 3px; color:var(--signal); font-size:.68rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-stage h2 { margin:0; font-family:Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif; font-size:clamp(1.25rem,2vw,2rem); font-weight:400; line-height:1.05; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-frame-field { min-height:260px; display:grid; place-items:stretch; padding:clamp(10px,1.5vw,18px); background:#20211e; } .ds-frame-shell { display:grid; place-items:center; width:100%; height:100%; background:var(--white); color:var(--ink); } .ds-stage footer { min-height:68px; padding:10px clamp(14px,2vw,26px); border-top:1px solid #3a3b36; color:#c7c8c0; font-size:.77rem; } @media(max-width:840px) { .ds-stage { min-height:520px; } .ds-frame-field { padding:0; } .ds-stage footer { min-height:112px; padding:9px 12px; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a private operating surface, not a campaign page. A compact command rail and paper prospect switchboard let reviewers search, filter, or jump across twenty five ranked concepts inside one review context, while the live stage presents the selected concept without losing list position.

The world remains warm, flat, and decisive. Georgia supplies editorial orientation; the sans-serif layer carries filtering, ranking, state, contact, and navigation. Paper and ink define the large fields, fine rules divide the workspace, and lime, green, and amber appear only as signals.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black command rail above a paper switchboard and dominant dark preview stage.
Editorial Georgia headings paired with a dense sans-serif operating layer.
Explicit search clearing, a native prospect jump, counted cohort tabs, and concise keyboard guidance.
Ruled full-width prospect rows instead of dashboard cards.
Square controls, flat surfaces, and tonal or planar state changes rather than elevation.
Rare lime action signals, quiet green readiness states, and explicit amber mail hold.
Responsive split-pane-to-overlay behavior that preserves reviewer context, status, and one active focus scope.

rules.name: The Signal Only Rule
rules.body: Lime is a locator and primary action color, not a large surface fill.

rules.name: The State Separation Rule
rules.body: Green means review-ready, amber means mail hold, and paper means scope; do not merge these states into one generic badge color.

rules.name: The Two-Speed Type Rule
rules.body: Georgia establishes location and current subject; sans-serif carries action, evidence, filtering, and state.

rules.name: The Short Serif Rule
rules.body: Keep serif text to short orientation phrases and business titles; dense metadata and control copy remain sans-serif.

rules.name: The Switchboard and Stage Rule
rules.body: Selection and inspection share one surface: the list preserves context while the stage presents the live concept.

rules.name: The Synchronized Selection Rule
rules.body: Every navigation path resolves to one active prospect: selected row, jump value, URL hash, stage content, and previous/next sequence update together.

rules.name: The Mobile Focus Boundary Rule
rules.body: Below `840px`, the closed stage is inert and `aria-hidden`; when it opens, the stage becomes interactive while the command rail and switchboard become inert and `aria-hidden`, Tab and Shift+Tab cycle within the stage controls, and closing restores focus to the selected prospect. At desktop widths, the persistent stage remains interactive.

rules.name: The Persistent Boundary Rule
rules.body: Compact layouts may reflow evidence, but they do not hide the rail summary or Mail Hold status.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Separate levels with field contrast and rules; do not add floating panels or ambient shadows.

rules.name: The Planar State Rule
rules.body: Prospect hover and focus may shift the row 4px laterally, but padding stays fixed and the row does not rise off the page.

rules.name: The Square Control Rule
rules.body: Interactive and status components do not introduce rounded or pill silhouettes.

dos: Do keep the operating surface warm, flat, square, and high contrast.
Do preserve the serif-orientation and sans-serif-operation split.
Do keep search clearing explicit, the native jump populated with all twenty five ranked prospects, and cohort counts visible.
Do keep the active row, jump select, URL hash, stage, and previous/next sequence synchronized.
Do keep prospect-row padding stable while hover and focus change background and translate the row 4px over 280ms.
Do label the ranked-row action Preview and keep the mobile switchboard tools sticky below the 60px rail.
Do enforce one mobile focus scope: only the switchboard is interactive while the stage is closed, and only the stage is interactive while the overlay is open.
Do keep the compact rail summary and Mail Hold status visible at 480px and below.
Do retain the 1120px, 840px, and 480px responsive reflows.
Do honor reduced-motion settings by collapsing animations and transitions to 0.01ms.
donts: Don't animate or expand prospect-row padding on hover or focus.
Don't replace the native jump select with a bespoke menu or let a control display a stale selection.
Don't let search, jump, cohort, count, and guidance tools scroll away on mobile.
Don't expose the closed mobile stage or the obscured rail and switchboard to keyboard or assistive-technology navigation.
Don't hide the compact rail summary or Mail Hold status to make mobile fit.
Don't convert the prospect switchboard into a card grid or add floating panels and shadows.
Don't turn tabs, actions, search, or status markers into pills or rounded controls.
Don't spread Signal Lime across large surfaces or collapse ready and hold into one state.
Don't use the private-review shell to standardize the individual concepts' business-specific visual worlds.
